name: BinValuesNode
label: Bin Values
description: Bins numeric values into equal-width buckets. Adds a column containing the bin label (e.g. '1', '2') and optionally the lower bound of each bin.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the numeric column to bin.

fields.name: NumberOfBins
fields.label: Number Of Bins
fields.description: The number of equal-width bins. Defaults to 4.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the bin column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_Bin'.

fields.name: BinnedDataTable
fields.label: Binned Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with the bin column.
